A '''civil war''' between factions of the crime syndicate known as [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] was engineered by the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] criminal [[Savan]]<ref name="Evo4" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], [[Gender/Legends|her]] uncle and head of Black Sun, the [[3 ABY/Legends|year prior]], the syndicate was left without leadership and split by conflicts between rival [[Vigo/Legends|lieutenants]]. In an attempt to unite the remnants of Black Sun under her control, Savan sought out the [[Human replica droid]] [[Guri]] for the secrets she carried as Xizor's former right hand,<ref name="TNEC" /> employing the [[Hiitian/Legends|Hiitian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kar Yang]] in the guise of "Azool," a male [[Antiques dealer/Legends|antiques dealer]], to locate the [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="Evo1">[[Shadows of the Empire: Evolution 1|''Shadows of the Empire: Evolution'' 1]]</ref>

At the same time, Savan had infiltrated Black Sun in a [[Human/Legends|Human]] identity, and incited internal conflict to eliminate her rivals.<ref name="Evo4" /> During a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] mission to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] aiming to negotiate an end to the war and avoid civilian casualties, the Falleen staged an attack pinned on Black Sun Vigo [[Vekker (Quarren)|Vekker]], creating a target for rival factions while she maintained a false pursuit of peace.<ref name="Evo3" /> However, New Republic leader [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] uncovered Savan's plot, and discovered that she had left for [[Hurd's Moon]]. Savan had tracked Guri to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]],<ref name="Evo4" /> where the Human replica droid had enlisted the advanced [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] [[A-OIC]] and its master [[Massad Thrumble]] to disable her [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin]] programming.<ref name="Evo3" /> Backed by [[Mercenary/Legends|hired]] forces, the Falleen breached Thrumble's secure [[Medcenter/Legends|surgical facility]] and attempted to command Guri with a control phrase. However, Thrumble's deprogramming had rendered the code inert, and Savan was incapacited by Guri and taken into New Republic custody,<ref name="Evo5" /> preventing the rise of her new Black Sun.<ref name="TNEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Black Sun civil war first appeared in the [[Shadows of the Empire: Evolution 3|third issue]] of the [[Dark Horse Comics]] series [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire: Evolution|''Shadows of the Empire: Evolution'']], written by [[Steve Perry]], illustrated by [[Ron Randall]],<ref name="Evo3" /> and published on [[April 8]]th, [[1998]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54551/star_wars_shadows_of_the_empire_-_evolution_1998_3|text=Star Wars: Shadows Of The Empire - Evolution (1998) #3}}</ref>

Although the faction led by the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] in this conflict was identified as the Rebel Alliance by Savan's entry of the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="TCSWESavan">{{CSWECite|III|128|Savan}}</ref> Guri's entry in the same book referred to it as the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="TCSWEGuri" /> the Alliance's successor.<ref name="TNEC" /> The original [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] also referred to the faction as the Alliance,<ref name="Evo5" /> but ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' placed the story in the early New Republic era.<ref name="TNEC" />
